source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check the information of dmidecode -t 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Information should be correct and still be correct after rebooting

deepseek_columns.ai_commands:
# SMBIOS version check (2.2): read SMBIOS version + confirm stable after reboot
sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 0 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'SMBIOS|BIOS Revision|Release Date'; sudo dmidecode --version"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the SMBIOS/BIOS version lines so the operator confirms SMBIOS 2.2 and that it stays correct after rebooting.

original_test_intent: Verify that the platform reports the source-required SMBIOS version 2.2 and approved Type 0 BIOS identity fields correctly, and that the same values persist after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete versioned dmidecode Type 0/header evidence before and after an approved reboot, bind both captures to the same SUT/firmware identity, compare required fields and preserve boot/BMC health evidence.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the complete unchanged collection/reboot plan and supplies expected values. No human physical or visual operation is inherent in the core test.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identity and expected SMBIOS 2.2 requirement
Approved reboot window, transport and console/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only dmidecode collection; never alter SMBIOS or firmware.
Preserve raw unfiltered output and command/tool versions before generating summaries.
Run the reboot only under the approved plan with OOB recovery and no active workload conflict.
Stop on identity mismatch, malformed table, boot/management loss or unexpected log evidence.
Do not automatically retry or conceal the original failed boot/collection.
agent_execution_scope: After plan approval, collect raw dmidecode/version/platform evidence, execute the approved software reboot, wait for defined readiness and repeat identical collection.
Compare complete fields and flag drift or log anomalies.
Do not invent expected values or issue the formal PASS/FAIL verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve expected fields, reboot plan, recovery and any project override to the source's 2.2 value.
Review discrepancies and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 0 is the source method, but grep-only evidence may omit the SMBIOS entry-point line and sshpass with disabled host-key checking is not an approved default transport.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use authenticated project transport, archive full sudo dmidecode -t 0 and relevant header output plus dmidecode --version before/after reboot, then derive a comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SMBIOS 2.2, the linked script, dmidecode method and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the SMBIOS entry-point version plus raw Type 0 fields and tool version before and after reboot; compare against a versioned platform recipe and retain full output.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Linux-accessible SMBIOS/DMI platforms with dmidecode support.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record dmidecode, kernel, BIOS and SMBIOS entry-point versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Installed dmidecode documentation and platform SMBIOS recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Keeps dmidecode but removes filtered-only evidence and adds deterministic reboot/identity correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; adds provenance and reboot health coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected SMBIOS/Type 0 matrix and reboot plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Type 0 is BIOS Information; the SMBIOS specification version is normally reported in the table header, so both must be retained.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different SMBIOS version for its platform. The report must identify that override and cannot claim the master source's literal 2.2 expectation was met unless it was actually evaluated.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected matrix, SUT/firmware identity and dmidecode version
Raw pre-reboot SMBIOS header and Type 0 output
Raw post-reboot output and field-level diff
Logs, project override if any and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, dmidecode method and persistence criterion are compatible. Exact expected Type 0 fields are project readiness data.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-and-reboot comparison is clear; missing package, expected fields or maintenance window does not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its automatable core while strengthening transport and evidence completeness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains reboot/recovery safeguards but corrects classification: package, SPEC and one-user plan approval are readiness inputs, not PARTIAL criteria.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates capability, readiness, execution and engineer verdict exactly as required by the locked logic.

review_improvement: Avoids confusing the SMBIOS entry-point version with only Type 0 fields and makes persistence evidence repeatable across reboot.
independent_technical_reasoning: Both collection and reboot can be software-controlled after a single approved unchanged plan. No human physical/UI acceptance is required, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is the correct capability classification.
